// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-IMPORT-ALLOWLIST
// The near miss the PR5 widening invites. @/lib/mailStatus is on the allowlist
// because it is closed string unions and two pure helpers. @/lib/mailer is NOT,
// and must never be: it holds the provider credentials and the send path, so
// permitting it would put "send an email to this address" inside the operator
// area, and the address itself one property away.
import { sendMail } from "@/lib/mailer";

export async function nudge(to: string) {
  return sendMail({ to, subject: "hello", text: "hello", html: "<p>hello</p>" });
}
